tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background (Stone). Website, docs and the editor's main area.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, dialogs and editor panels. ink 15.3:1 light, 13.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: sandstone
tokens.usage: Bands and table heads on the website. ink 11.4:1 light, 11.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Editor sidebar only. ink 12.6:1 light, 14.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default text and the wordmark on ground, surface, sandstone, sidebar and every *-soft fill. 13.8:1 on ground light, 15.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: lead paragraphs, descriptions, metadata. 7.1:1 or more on ground, surface, sandstone and sidebar in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions, placeholders and timestamps on ground, surface and sidebar. Not on sandstone. 5.2:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders that carry no meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons. 3.3:1 or more on ground, surface and sidebar in both themes.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Malachite. The one action colour: primary buttons, links, the active navigation item. As text 5.3:1 or more on ground, surface, sidebar and primary-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary fills and links.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and primary-hover. 6.5:1 light, 8.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Published status and of selected rows. Text on it: ink or primary.

tokens.name: glint
tokens.usage: The glint of mica: sparkles, the dot of the Not published status, a marker on what changed. A fill only, never text. At most a small share of any view.

tokens.name: on-glint
tokens.usage: Text on a glint fill, in both themes. 9.4:1.

tokens.name: glint-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Saved, not published status and of warning notices. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: strata
tokens.usage: Strata blue. Information, the focus ring, and the Astro rocket. As text 5.6:1 or more on ground, surface and strata-soft in both themes; as a ring 5.2:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: on-strata
tokens.usage: Text on a strata fill. 7.0:1 light, 7.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid with a 2px offset, on every surface. Alias of strata.

tokens.name: strata-soft
tokens.usage: Background of information notices and of code: inline code, commands and the path bar of a code block. Text on it: ink 12.0:1 or more, ink-muted 7.7:1 or more, strata, primary and danger 4.9:1 or more, in both themes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Hematite. Errors, conflicts and actions that remove work. Never decoration. As text 4.9:1 or more on ground, surface and danger-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of danger buttons.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger and danger-hover fills. 6.2:1 light, 8.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error notices and the Conflict status. Text on it: ink or danger.

tokens.name: band-glint
tokens.usage: Strata illustration only: the top band. Decoration, no contrast floor.

tokens.name: band-sand
tokens.usage: Strata illustration only. Never directly on ground at the top of a stack.

tokens.name: band-malachite
tokens.usage: Strata illustration only.

tokens.name: band-blue
tokens.usage: Strata illustration only.

tokens.name: band-shale
tokens.usage: Strata illustration only: the deepest band. Lighter in dark so it stays visible on ground.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Website
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque for headlines on the website and for docs page titles. Sentence case.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The hero headline. Once per page.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Section headlines on the website; docs page titles.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Instrument Sans for all running text, on every surface.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Mica keeps your content as plain files in your Git repository.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a headline. ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each publish is one tidy commit that your build can read.
styles.usage: Website and docs body text. 60 to 75 characters a line.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a website headline. primary or ink-muted. Website only.

groups.name: Editor
groups.note: The editor is calmer: Instrument Sans only, smaller steps, no display face.

styles.name: editor-title
styles.usage: The entry title at the top of a form; page titles.

styles.name: editor-body
styles.sample: Saved. It goes on the website when you publish.

styles.name: editor-label
styles.usage: Field labels, table heads, status pills.

styles.name: editor-help
styles.sample: Shown in the browser tab and in search results.
styles.usage: Help text under a field. ink-subtle.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono where the text is a thing a computer reads: paths, commands, file contents.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Website sections use the large steps; the editor stays at space-5 or below.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; dot to status word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside pills and chips; between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label to input; button padding (vertical, website).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Editor panel padding; gaps in forms; phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between form groups; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Website card padding; gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a website section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between website sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between website sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Inputs, code chips, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Buttons, notices, editor panels, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Website cards, code blocks, screenshots.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and the active website navigation item.

shadow.note: Borders before shadows. One shadow, for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs only.
